       -

       an excellent win for the West Indies, it looked like a small
        target, but was more than enough, without even needing the 3 over
        penalty
       the crowd has gone beserk, the whole outfield is one big mass
        jumping up and down to the same rhythm
       the outstanding player of the day was Hendy Bryan, playing on
        debut, ripping the Australian middle order to shreads
       but as far as the batting goes, both sides were very lame, Campbell
        by far the top scorer and thatw as a very messy innings
       and the man of the match is predictably Bryan
       Bryan: says it's a wonderful debut... takes his award and poses for
        a photo
       next ODI is from Grenada, first top level match there in a long
        while, Apr 14 1335 GMT
       good day from CI
